content.text:
Locke task: ENTIRE INTEGRATION (Claude Code). One PR that makes Entire checkpoints and analytics work, and documents how every agent must use it. Entire is a MANDATORY hackathon tool (judged: "Entire checkpoints or entire-graph output from the repository").

Current state (audited by the orchestrator):
- The Entire CLI 0.11.4 is installed, and git hooks are in the shared .git/hooks.
- The user ran `entire enable` in the main checkout D:/hackathon/Locke. The resulting config (.entire/settings.json, .claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks.json, .agents/hooks.json) is UNTRACKED there and NOT on main.
- ZERO commits on any branch carry an `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer, and there are no refs/entire/* locally or on origin.
- `entire doctor` warns "Codex-discovered hooks are out of date" and "Codex project layer missing in this worktree".
- Likely cause: agent session hooks aren't committed, and sessions that enabled Entire mid-run never loaded them.
Background research: C:/Users/govin/.ao/data/artifacts/locke-1/research-partners-judging.md §1 (commands). VERIFY every command and flag against `entire --help`, `entire <cmd> --help` and https://docs.entire.io before relying on it or documenting it. Don't invent flags.

Work on a new branch off the latest origin/main. Do these steps in order:
1. Generate and commit the Entire config in your worktree: `entire enable --agent claude-code`, then `entire agent add` for codex, cursor and antigravity (whatever names `entire agent` supports). Run `entire doctor` and fix every warning. Commit .entire/settings.json and all the agent hook files. Never commit secrets or machine-local state; gitignore anything local, e.g. .entire/settings.local.json, .entire/logs, .entire/metadata if those are local-only.
2. `entire plugin install graph`, then `entire graph init-agents --repo .`. Keep the managed block it writes into AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md small.
3. Repo fixes:
   - .gitignore currently has `.env*`; add `!.env.example`.
   - package.json typecheck script → `next typegen && tsc --noEmit`, so a clean checkout passes.
   - Cherry-pick these already-reviewed commits that never reached main: `git cherry-pick a888fe5 5721dbd b87bc08`.
4. UPDATE AGENTS.md: replace §10 with a complete "Entire (mandatory)" section that every harness follows. It should cover:
   - Session-start check: `entire status` must show Enabled with your agent listed. If not, stop and tell the orchestrator.
   - Commit cadence, push cadence, and how to verify a checkpoint after each commit (e.g. `git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key=Entire-Checkpoint)'`).
   - Never squash, rebase or force-push checkpointed commits; merge PRs with merge commits.
   - Analytics and evidence commands: `entire checkpoint list`, `checkpoint explain <id> [--json]`, `checkpoint tokens <id> --compare <id>` (before/after), `entire recap`, and the entire-graph commands (impact/diff/health/checkpoint). Say when to use each, and that exports go to evidence/entire/.
   - Use `entire graph` before large edits (blast radius, saves tokens).
   - PR body requirements: list the checkpoint ids plus entire.io links (https://entire.io/gh/Navin-nash/Locke/commit/<sha>).
   - Definition of done: commits checkpointed and refs pushed.
   - In the ORCHESTRATOR DISPATCH section: start new worker sessions only after this config is on main; restart long-running sessions at task boundaries so hooks load; spread checkpointed work across all 4 harnesses.
5. UPDATE CLAUDE.md: add a short Claude-Code-specific Entire section. Cover:
   - Hooks live in .claude/settings.json and load at session start, so restart the session if Entire was enabled mid-session.
   - Only subagents launched with run_in_background are captured.
   - `entire checkpoint explain --generate` uses the Claude CLI.
   - Which entire-graph commands to use for context.
   Keep it consistent with AGENTS.md (no duplication; reference the AGENTS.md section).
6. PROVE IT WORKS:
   - From your own agent session, make a real change, commit it, and show that the commit has an `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer and that `entire checkpoint list` shows it.
   - Push, then show that `git ls-remote origin 'refs/entire/*'` is non-empty.
   - Also check whether `entire import` (or similar) can backfill today's earlier agent sessions for this repo as checkpoints; if so, run it and push.
   - Paste all of this output in the PR body.
   If a checkpoint still doesn't appear, debug it systematically (superpowers:systematic-debugging) and report the exact cause.

Keep pnpm lint, typecheck, test and build green. Push and open a PR "chore: Entire integration (config, docs, verified checkpoints)" against main (standing approval). Do not merge. Finish with `ao report`, including the PR URL and the verification output.
I'll start by checking the repo state and the Entire CLI.

=== enable
Enable Entire with session tracking for your AI agent workflows.

If Entire is not yet configured, this runs the full configuration flow.
If Entire is already configured but disabled, this re-enables it.

If the current directory is not a git repository, Entire can initialize one
for you and create an initial commit. It never creates or pushes to a remote —
publish the repository yourself when you're ready.

Usage:
  entire enable [flags]

Flags:
      --absolute-git-hook-path               Embed full binary path in git hooks (for GUI git clients that don't source shell profiles)
      --agent string                         Agent to set up hooks for (e.g., antigravity, claude-code, codex, copilot-cli, cursor, factoryai-droid, opencode, pi; external agents on $PATH are also available). Enables non-interactive mode.
      --agent-help-skill entire agent-help   Install the stable Entire agent-help skill (points agents at entire agent-help) for selected agent(s)
      --checkpoint-backend string            Checkpoint storage backend: refs (default; one git ref per checkpoint) or branch (legacy shared entire/checkpoints/v1 branch)
      --checkpoint-push-remote string        Git remote for checkpoint uploads (saved to .entire/settings.local.json, even with --project)
      --checkpoint-remote string             Checkpoint remote in provider:owner/repo format; providers: github, gitlab (e.g., github:org/checkpoints-repo)
  -f, --force                                Force reinstall hooks (removes existing Entire hooks first)
  -h, --help                                 help for enable
      --import-history                       During first-time setup, import the selected agents' existing session history (last 30 days) without prompting
      --init-repo                            If not a git repo, initialize one non-interactively
      --initial-commit-message string        Commit message for the initial commit when bootstrapping a new repo
      --local                                Write settings to .entire/settings.local.json instead of .entire/settings.json
      --no-init-repo                         If not a git repo, exit instead of prompting to initialize one
      --project                              Write settings to .entire/settings.json even if it already exists
      --search-skill                         Install the optional Entire search skill for selected agent(s)
      --skip-initial-commit                  Don't create the initial commit when bootstrapping a new repo
      --skip-push-sessions                   Disable automatic pushing of session logs on git push
      --telemetry                            Enable anonymous usage analytics (default true)
  -y, --yes                                  Accept all defaults without prompting (in a non-repo directory: init git and commit; then enable all agents and accept telemetry). Does not import existing agent history — see --import-history

=== plugin
Manage Entire plugins.

Plugins are external executables named 'entire-<name>'. The CLI discovers
plugins on $PATH and from a per-user managed directory which is
auto-prepended to PATH at startup. The managed directory is, in order of
precedence:

  $ENTIRE_PLUGIN_DIR/bin (override)
  $XDG_DATA_HOME/entire/plugins/bin (Linux/macOS, when set)
  ~/.local/share/entire/plugins/bin (Linux/macOS default)
  %LOCALAPPDATA%\entire\plugins\bin (Windows, when set)
  ~\AppData\Local\entire\plugins\bin (Windows fallback when LOCALAPPDATA is unset)

Install sources:
  entire plugin install run                                    index lookup
  entire plugin install https://github.com/entireio/entire-run repository URL
  entire plugin install ./dist/entire-run                      local executable

Remote installs resolve the newest semver tag over the git protocol, then
download the platform's release asset (verified against the release's
checksums.txt when published). Discovery uses a git-synced plugin index;
see 'entire plugin search' and 'entire plugin index update'.

Usage:
  entire plugin [command]

Available Commands:
  browse      Interactively browse the plugin index and install
  doctor      Check installed plugins for missing dependencies and broken entries
  index       Manage the plugin index
  info        Show index and install details for a plugin
  install     Install a plugin from the index, a git repository URL, or a local executable
  list        List plugins installed in the managed directory
  remove      Remove a plugin from the managed directory
  search      Search the plugin index
  upgrade     Upgrade remote-installed plugins to their newest tag

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for plugin

Global Flags:
      --context name   Act as this saved login name for this command only — including the git and agent processes it spawns — instead of the active context (entire auth contexts lists them)

Use "entire plugin [command] --help" for more information about a command.
=== plugin install
Install a plugin.

Three source forms:

  name   Bare names resolve through the plugin index:
             entire plugin install run
  url    Full git repository URLs install from any git host. The newest
         semver tag is resolved with 'git ls-remote'; the platform's release
         asset is downloaded over HTTPS and verified against the release's
         checksums.txt. A release that publishes no checksums is refused
         unless --allow-unverified is passed:
             entire plugin install https://github.com/entireio/entire-run
  path   Local executables are linked into the managed directory (symlink
         first, so rebuilds are picked up immediately). Paths must be
         explicit — a separator or leading ./ — so a stray local file can
         never shadow an index name:
             entire plugin install ./dist/entire-run
             entire plugin install ./entire-run

Installing from a URL that is not listed in the plugin index asks for
confirmation; pass --yes to skip (required in non-interactive runs).

Plugins may declare dependencies in entire-plugin.yml. Missing dependencies
are listed and installed after a single confirmation (or with --yes);
--no-deps opts out.

Usage:
  entire plugin install <name|url|path> [flags]

Flags:
      --allow-unverified   Install even when the release publishes no checksums.txt to authenticate the download
      --force              Replace an existing entry with the same name
  -h, --help               help for install
      --index string       Plugin index URL (overrides ENTIRE_PLUGIN_INDEX_URL and the built-in default)
      --no-deps            Do not install declared dependencies
      --pin string         Install exactly this tag and skip it during 'plugin upgrade'
      --yes                Skip confirmation prompts (non-index sources, dependency installs)

=== checkpoint
Operations on checkpoints — the persistent records of agent work tied to commits.

Commands:
  list     List checkpoints on the current branch
  explain  Explain a checkpoint, commit, or session
  tokens   Show token usage and optimization recommendations
  search   Search checkpoints (semantic + keyword)

Examples:
  entire checkpoint list
  entire checkpoint explain <id|sha>
  entire checkpoint tokens <id>

Usage:
  entire checkpoint [command]

Aliases:
  checkpoint, cp, checkpoints

Available Commands:
  explain     Explain a session, commit, or checkpoint
  list        List checkpoints on the current branch
  search      Search checkpoints, commits, and sessions using semantic and keyword matching
  tokens      Show token usage and optimization recommendations for a checkpoint

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for checkpoint

Global Flags:
      --context name   Act as this saved login name for this command only — including the git and agent processes it spawns — instead of the active context (entire auth contexts lists them)

Use "entire checkpoint [command] --help" for more information about a command.
=== doctor
Scan for session issues and offer to fix them.

Checks performed:
  1. Disconnected metadata branches: detects when local and remote
     entire/checkpoints/v1 branches share no common ancestor (caused by a
     previous bug). Fixes by cherry-picking local checkpoints onto remote tip.

  2. Operational logs: warn when .entire/logs cannot be written. Every other
     diagnostic is delivered by writing there, and that write is silent about
     its own failure, so an unwritable log directory looks exactly like a repo
     where nothing ran.

  When Codex hooks are installed:
  3. Codex hook trust: warn when hooks declared in .codex/hooks.json
     lack a trusted_hash entry in the user's Codex config (i.e. /hooks
     review hasn't run yet on this machine, or a newer entire release
     added a hook the user hasn't approved yet).

  For each installed agent that reports hook-config drift:
  4. Hook config: warn when the installed hooks no longer match what this
     CLI writes (e.g. an older release wrote Claude Code tool matchers that
     no longer fire, or a committed Pi/OpenCode extension has gone stale).
     Fix by re-running 'entire enable --force'.

  5. Retired Gemini CLI hooks: remove Entire hook entries left in
     .gemini/settings.json. Gemini CLI support was removed; the entries now do
     nothing but run a no-op on every Gemini event.

  6. Summary provider: warn when summary_generation.provider names a registered
     agent that cannot generate text (e.g. factoryai-droid), which makes
     'entire checkpoint explain --generate', 'entire dispatch' and
     'entire runner setup' fail. Reports the file to change; does not rewrite it.

  7. Stuck sessions: sessions stuck in ACTIVE or ENDED phase that need cleanup.

A session is considered stuck if:
  - It is in ACTIVE phase with no interaction for over 1 hour
  - It is in ENDED phase with uncondensed checkpoint data on a shadow branch

For each stuck session, you can choose to:
  - Condense: Save session data to permanent storage
  - Discard: Remove the session state and shadow branch data
  - Skip: Leave the session as-is

Use --force to condense all fixable sessions without prompting.  Sessions that can't
be condensed will be discarded.

Without a terminal to prompt on (agents, CI), doctor reports each issue and
points at --force instead of prompting.

=== status
Show whether Entire is currently enabled or disabled

Flags:
